notes.title: The Archive Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34946933/eceb27b70c1737a1bab59ff65f531d1c20677bc0.gif[/img]

The Archive Update now packages DUSTNET onto a single dedicated server box that will preserve de_dust2 forever. With only 16-slots, every change players make to the DUSTNET server will be saved for future visitors. Pruning of the server will be important as the user generated structures grow, for more information please visit our [url=http://scrnprnt.ca/discord]Discord[/url].

[h2]Changelist[/h2]
[list][*]A single 16-slot dedicated DUSTNET server now saves all map changes PERMANENTLY 
[*]Autosave is triggered every 10 minutes and the last player on the server has access to a manual /save command
[*]UI updates for every platform
[*]Individual player editing limit removed
[*]AR players can no longer attack other players
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34946933/3a2388096c7cd61d7264008f3c7675b993c94c91.gif[/img]

notes.title: DUSTNET 1.0.0 v3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34946933/9ec08a4361599af34642d4548e9b9c59e93d0beb.gif[/img]

This update adds new features for PC players (glowy lava) and support for Windows Mixed Reality controllers, the Valve Index is still only partially supported.

Get on [b]DUSTNET[/b] server every [b]Tuesday at 5pm PST / 8pm EST[/b] and join the [url=http://scrnprnt.ca/discord]Discord[/url]

[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[list]
[*] Player count visible in team select
[*] Idle mode option added to team select
[*] A new /fx command enables bloom, blur, and grain for PC players
[*] Windows Mixed Reality controller support
[*] VR movement greatly improved
[/list]

notes.title: DUSTNET 1.0.0 v2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34946933/6e3f9e87eba676a1ba55006d319d7dddef86e9d5.gif[/img]

A minor update to [b]DUSTNET[/b], it adds a few features and clarifies the server state better. Support for Index and WMR headsets coming soon. 

[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[list]
[*]Server object limit indicator added to edit mode
[*]T-posing makes players invulnerable to VR slaps
[*]Simplified Chinese, Katakana, and Hiragana characters supported
[*]Send team chat with shift+enter
[*]Tutorial for bhop, edit mode, and chat
[*]CT and T heads now spin
[*]Talk particles less annoying to VR players
[*]Indicator for when the knife can be used (while bhopping)
[*]Bhop timer now supports times over an hour
[/list]
